- Common stock (LEH)
- Preferred depositary shares, Series C, D, F, G, J, and P

- Opta Exchange-Traded Notes (EOH, RAW, PPE-related notes as listed)
- Medium Term Notes (LBM.B, LBM.C)
- SUNS Stock Upside Note Securities (PSZ.F, LSQ.C, LSQ.D, PSZ.E)

I found an issuer or exchange filing for every last-trading-day and exit-type fact. I could not get a single Standard & Poor's index-change release itself (their own announcement, not a reprint or news report). So every S&P removal fact below is graded SECONDARY, except one Bear Stearns item that comes from the company that replaced it. None of the fetched pages had text addressed to AI agents.

Three last-trading-day values (Bear Stearns, Wachovia, Countrywide) are inferred from Form 25-NSE suspension wording; no fetched document states them directly. Please confirm against your price data.

---

**1. WACHOVIA (WB)**

WB / LAST NYSE DAY: 2008-12-31 (inferred)
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/36995/000087666109000008/0000876661-09-000008.txt
DOC: Form 25-NSE, New York Stock Exchange, filed 2009-01-02
EXCERPT: "The merger between Wachovia Corporation and Wells Fargo & Company became automatically effective at 11:59 P.M., NYC time, on December 31, 2008." … "this security was suspended from trading on January 2, 2009." … "at the opening of business on January 12, 2009"
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: No fetched document names the last trading day. January 1 was a holiday and the suspension is dated January 2, 2009, so 2008-12-31 is inferred. Formal delisting was 2009-01-12.

WB / S&P 500 REMOVAL: after the close on 2008-12-31; replaced by Owens-Illinois (OI)
URL: https://www.planadviser.com/financial-services-shifts-shake-up-sp-500/
DOC: "Financial Services Shifts Shake Up S&P 500", PLANADVISER, 2008-12-24
EXCERPT: "Owens-Illinois Inc. (ticker: OI) will replace Wachovia in the S&P 500 after the close of trading on Wednesday, December 31."
GRADE: SECONDARY
NOTE: Wikipedia's "Historical components" page also lists December 31, 2008. The S&P release itself was NOT FOUND.

WB / EXIT TYPE: stock, 0.1991 Wells Fargo (WFC) share per WB share, plus cash for fractional shares
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000072971/000089882209000002/wellsfargo_8k.htm
DOC: Wells Fargo Form 8-K12B, signed 2009-01-02
EXCERPT: "the right to receive 0.1991 of a share of Wells Fargo common stock"
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: The Form 25-NSE above confirms the 0.1991 ratio.

---

**2. LEHMAN BROTHERS (LEH)**

LEH / LAST NYSE DAY: 2008-09-17
URL: https://www.nasdaqtrader.com/content/phlxmemos/2008/sep/1648-08.pdf
DOC: NASDAQ OMX PHLX Memo #1648-08, 2008-09-18
EXCERPT: "Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc. (LEH) was delisted from trading on the NYSE following the close of business on Wednesday, September 17, 2008. A market for the underlying shares is now available on the Pink Sheets, beginning on Thursday, September 18, 2008, under the symbol LEHMQ."
GRADE: PRIMARY (an exchange notice, but from PHLX, not NYSE)
NOTE: Lehman's own 8-K backs this up. It shows a NYSE close on Sept 17: "which closed at $0.14 per share on September 17, 2008" (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/806085/000110465908059900/a08-22764_68k.htm, signed 2008-09-23). The 8-K and NYSE's release only say the suspension was "immediate", with no time of day. NYSE's Form 25 sets formal removal "at the opening of business on October 27, 2008" (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/876661/000087666108000420/ruleprovisionnotice.htm). The PHLX memo's wording "delisted" really means trading was suspended.

LEH / LAST OTC DAY: NOT FOUND
URL: https://www.finra.org/sites/default/files/UPCNotice/p125764.pdf
DOC: FINRA Uniform Practice Advisory UPC #13-12, 2012-03-06
EXCERPT: "became effective on March 06, 2012. Pursuant to the Plan, On the Effective Date, all LBHI Stock shall be cancelled"
GRADE: PRIMARY for the cancellation; NOT FOUND for the last OTC trade date
NOTE: The stock was cancelled on 2012-03-06. The advisory does not give a last LEHMQ trading date.

LEH / S&P 500 REMOVAL: after the close on 2008-09-16; replaced by Harris Corp. (Occidental Petroleum replaced it in the S&P 100)
URL: https://www.nationalmortgagenews.com/news/lehman-removed-from-stock-indices
DOC: "Lehman removed from stock indices", National Mortgage News, 2008-09-16
EXCERPT: "Standard & Poor's said Lehman will be removed from the S&P 500 and S&P 100 indices after the close of trading Sept. 16."
GRADE: SECONDARY
NOTE: S&P removed LEH about one trading day before NYSE trading stopped (Sept 17). Your golden case should allow index exit to come before the last exchange trade. The S&P release was NOT FOUND.

LEH / EXIT TYPE: bankruptcy and delisting (Chapter 11 filed 2008-09-15); equity cancelled with no distribution
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/806085/000110465908059900/a08-22764_68k.htm
DOC: Lehman Brothers Holdings Form 8-K, event 2008-09-17
EXCERPT: The fetch tool only summarised the reason for suspension (the Sept 15 Chapter 11 filing, NYSE Listed Company Manual Section 802.01D) and would not quote it at length.
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: The FINRA advisory above says former holders "shall neither receive nor retain any Property of the Estate" unless all senior claim classes are paid in full.

---

**3. BEAR STEARNS (BSC)**

BSC / LAST NYSE DAY: 2008-05-30 (inferred)
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000777001/000091412108000468/be13005142-8k.txt
DOC: Bear Stearns Form 8-K, signed 2008-06-02
EXCERPT: "trading of the Common Stock on the NYSE ceased before the opening of trading on June 2, 2008."
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: June 2 was a Monday, so the last trading day is inferred as Friday May 30. BSC / S&P 500 REMOVAL: effective 2008-06-02, which is when Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) joined; the exact S&P timing wording was NOT FOUND
URL (A): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526714000009/isrg-20131231x10k.htm
DOC: Intuitive Surgical Form 10-K for FY2013
EXCERPT: "our Company became a component of the S&P 500 Index on June 2, 2008."
GRADE: PRIMARY for ISRG's join date; the link to Bear Stearns comes from source B
URL (B): https://www.rttnews.com/614035/intuitive-surgical-advances-in-pre-market-after-addition-to-s-p-500-index.aspx
DOC: RTTNews, 2008-05-23
EXCERPT: "bumped up to the S&P 500 Index from the S&P Midcap 400 Index in replace of Bear Stearns (BSC)."
GRADE: SECONDARY
NOTE: Joining on June 2 fits "prior to the open on June 2" / "after the close on May 30", but neither phrase was found. An ECGI academic paper's appendix (secondary) lists BSC's removal as "June 2". Wikipedia's historical table has no BSC row.

BSC / EXIT TYPE: stock, 0.21753 JPMorgan Chase (JPM) share per BSC share
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000777001/000091412108000468/be13005142-8k.txt
DOC: Bear Stearns Form 8-K, 2008-06-02
EXCERPT: "was converted into the right to receive 0.21753 of a share of JPMorgan Chase common stock"
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: The ratio first announced on March 16, 2008 was 0.05473 (a search-result summary of JPMorgan's release; I did not fetch it myself). 0.21753 is the final, amended ratio. Use 0.21753.

---

**4. COUNTRYWIDE (CFC)**

CFC / LAST NYSE DAY: 2008-06-30 (inferred)
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/25191/000087666108000267/0000876661-08-000267.txt
DOC: Form 25-NSE, New York Stock Exchange, filed 2008-07-01
EXCERPT: "The merger between Countrywide Financial Corporation and Red Oak Merger Corporation … became effective before the opening on July 1, 2008." … "this security was suspended from trading on July 1, 2008"
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: The merger took effect before the open on July 1, so June 30 is inferred as the last day. Formal removal was "at the opening of business on July 11, 2008". Bank of America's 8-K says the deal was "completed effective as of July 1, 2008" (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000095014408005220/g14113ke8vk.htm).

CFC / S&P 500 REMOVAL: after the close on 2008-06-30; replaced by AK Steel Holding
URL: https://www.aist.org/ak-steel-holding-to-replace-countryside-financial-on-s-p-500-index
DOC: AIST news item (a steel trade association), 2008-06-27
EXCERPT: "will take place after the close of trading on Monday, June 30." The reason given is "Countrywide's acquisition by S&P 100/ S&P 500 constituent Bank of America."
GRADE: SECONDARY
NOTE: The headline misspells it "Countryside". Wikipedia dates this change July 1, 2008, which is the effective-open convention, and gives the wrong reason ("Market capitalization changes"). Watch which date convention you use. The S&P release was NOT FOUND.

CFC / EXIT TYPE: stock, 0.1822 share per CFC share
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/25191/000087666108000267/0000876661-08-000267.txt
DOC: Form 25-NSE, NYSE, 2008-07-01
EXCERPT: "Each share of Common Stock of Countrywide Financial Corporation was converted into 0.1822 of a share"
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: The excerpt I got cuts off before naming the issuer. That it is Bank of America (BAC) stock comes from search summaries of the January 11, 2008 merger agreement; I did not fetch that agreement. A second Form 25-NSE covers CFC's preferred stock purchase rights, which "expired and became null and void on July 1, 2008". It is not about the common stock.

---

**What to keep in mind for the golden cases**
- For BSC, WB and CFC, S&P's removal and the last NYSE trading day fall on the same date. For LEH, the S&P exit (after the close Sept 16) came one trading day before the last NYSE trade (Sept 17), and the stock then traded OTC as LEHMQ from Sept 18.
- To get from SECONDARY to PRIMARY on the S&P facts, the next things to try are Wayback Machine snapshots of standardandpoors.com index-announcement pages from 2008 and newswire archives.
